remarks: Utilities Included! 60 Pemberwick Road, Greenwich, CT 06831. Sunny 2-Bedroom + Office Apartment + Sunroom/Patio. Enjoy the comfort and convenience of this bright and spacious apartment with electric and gas utilities included! Large Eat-In Kitchen - Gourmet cabinetry, granite countertops, dishwasher, electric stove/oven, and refrigerator.  Enclosed Sunroom/Patio - Perfect for morning coffee or relaxing evenings, located right off the kitchen.  Spacious Bedrooms & Office -  Primary Bedroom: 12' x 12'  Second Bedroom: 12' x 10'  Office/Study: 12' x 8'  Ample Storage - Walk-in closets and additional storage space included.  Private Laundry - Washer and dryer on-site for the apartment.  Modern Touches - Decorative lighting fixtures throughout.  This home offers a practical layout with plenty of natural light, ideal for comfortable living in the desirable Greenwich community.
